questionText:
Rearrange the parts in the correct sequence to form a meaningful
sentence.

options.text:
while the anti-oxidants in it are known to neutralize free radicals that
damage cells in

curcumin in turmeric has strong anti-inflammatory effects, which may
help reduce

the body and cause neurodegenerative and cardiovascular disease and
cancer

chronic inflammation linked to various diseases like arthritis, heart and
bowel disease

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
The sentence begins with the active subject in (B) ('curcumin in turmeric has strong anti-inflammatory effects, which may help reduce'). The object clause is (D) ('chronic inflammation linked to various diseases like arthritis, heart and bowel disease'). The coordinate clause in (A) ('while the anti-oxidants in it are known to neutralize free radicals that damage cells in') flows directly into (C) ('the body and cause neurodegenerative and cardiovascular disease and cancer'). This forms (B)-(D)-(A)-(C).
Hence, option (D) is correct.

Hence, Option (C) is the correct answer.
